scripts.setup: npm ci && playwright install chromium && npm run build
scripts.inspect: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js inspect
scripts.rehearsal: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js rehearsal
scripts.full-rehearsal: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js full-rehearsal
scripts.live: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js live
scripts.doctor: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js doctor
scripts.monitor:setup: npm run build --silent && node dist/monitor-cli.js setup
scripts.monitor: npm run build --silent && node dist/monitor-cli.js serve
scripts.monitor:start: npm run build --silent && node dist/monitor-cli.js service-start
scripts.monitor:stop: npm run build --silent && node dist/monitor-cli.js service-stop
scripts.monitor:status: npm run build --silent && node dist/monitor-cli.js service-status
scripts.monitor:demo: npm run build --silent && node dist/monitor-cli.js serve --demo
scripts.monitor:funnel: npm run build --silent && node dist/monitor-cli.js funnel
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test -- --maxWorkers=1
